planets.name: HD 108236 f
planets.description: Transiting planet of HD 108236 with a 29.5-day year, found in 2021.

text.card: HD 108236 f was found in 2021 by CHEOPS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 5 planets known around HD 108236. Its orbit and size follow Bonfanti et al. 2021's fit, the archive's default.
